What gets in the way today

{{icon:circle-alert}}

Tedious valuation data entry

Audit and valuation teams spend hours re-keying PDF financial statements into Excel for DCF and business valuations.

{{icon:circle-alert}}

Transfer pricing peer sourcing

Defensible comparable peer datasets and activity codes for transfer pricing documentation are hard to find.

{{icon:circle-alert}}

Client charge verification

Client loan schedules and encumbrance details have to be reconciled against the official company registry’s charge records.

{{icon:circle-alert}}

Historical capital verification

Statutory audits require tracing several years of share allotments, equity class conversions and capital adjustments.

{{icon:circle-alert}}

Auditor note reconciliation

Qualification paragraphs and emphasis-of-matter notes have to be found across many historical balance sheet filings.

{{icon:circle-alert}}

Slow document retrieval

Slow government portal downloads hold up urgent tax audit working papers and compliance certificates.
